about.title: About this shop
paragraphs: This storefront is a demo: every product, order and user in it exists to show what the boilerplate underneath can do. The catalogue is small on purpose — small enough that you can watch stock move when you buy, see a category chip filter the list, and cancel an order you placed a minute ago.
Under the hood it is a Vue 3 frontend paired with a Node/MongoDB API, sharing one OpenAPI contract. Everything you click here calls the same endpoints a real deployment would.
Poke at it. Sign up, save something to the wishlist, break the checkout by ordering more than the shelf holds — the error you get is the same one a real customer would.

faq.title: FAQ
paragraphs: The questions a demo shop gets asked.

entries.a: No. Products, prices and orders are seeded demo data; no payment is ever taken and nothing ships.

entries.q: Why is one product always out of stock?
entries.a: On purpose — a shop where nothing is ever scarce cannot demonstrate what happens at checkout when something is.

entries.q: Can I use this code for my own shop?
entries.a: Yes: it is a boilerplate. Replace the seed data, the copy on these pages and the theme, and the rest is yours to keep or delete.

entries.q: Where do my contact messages go?
entries.a: Into the admin inbox on this very site — log in as an admin and you can move them through their statuses.

terms.title: Terms of service
paragraphs: This is a demonstration site. Nothing sold here exists, no order creates an obligation, and no payment is ever collected.
Accounts you create may be deleted at any time when the demo data resets. Do not store anything you care about in them — including your real, everyday password.
The software itself is distributed under the licence in the repository; these pages describe the demo deployment, not the code.

privacy.title: Privacy
paragraphs: The demo stores the account data you type in — email, username, saved addresses — and nothing else. It is kept only to make the demo work and disappears when the dataset resets.
Anonymous usage analytics may be collected to see which parts of the demo get exercised. Nothing collected is sold, shared, or joined with any other dataset.
To remove your data immediately, delete your account from the profile page: the deletion flow is real even though the shop is not.
